items.followUp: Define diffusion in liquids and give one example.

rubric.why: Checks the definition of diffusion in gases.
rubric.description: Diffusion is the spontaneous intermixing of gas particles due to their random motion.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for describing gas particles mixing or spreading spontaneously.

rubric.why: Checks whether the student can give a relevant example.
rubric.description: An example is the smell of perfume spreading through a room.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a valid example of a gas spreading and mixing.

modelAnswer: Diffusion in gases is the spontaneous intermixing of gas particles due to their random motion.
For example, the smell of perfume spreads through a room.
